question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Walden, Bob gets Dracula, and Claire gets Siddhartha.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Claire and Alice swap books. Then, Alice and Claire swap books. Finally, Bob and Claire swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Walden
(B) Dracula
(C) Siddhartha
solution:
Books are listed in order (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (Walden, Dracula, Siddhartha)
1. Claire and Alice swap: (Siddhartha, Dracula, Walden)
2. Alice and Claire swap: (Walden, Dracula, Siddhartha)
3. Bob and Claire swap: (Walden, Siddhartha, Dracula)
Bob has Siddhartha, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
